evidenceSources.excerpt: a professional clothing boutique where career seekers can go to select from gently used professional attire
MesaCAN, 635 E. Broadway Rd., Mesa, AZ 85204

researchNotes: Government school and workforce searches examined public programs and benefits routes. School results did not establish a clothing pathway. One City of Mesa URL failed; county alternative was read. No closure inferred. Current workforce eligibility cannot automatically be applied to an independently operated clothing boutique.

executionReceipt.coverageNotes: Examined Public programs; Contracted providers; Benefits and eligibility pathways through government school and county workforce sources. Three web calls, two queries, three opens including one failure. Contract instruments and broad benefit programs not exhaustively examined.
remainingGaps: Current operation and clothing-specific intake at Workforce Center @ Mesa boutique unresolved.
School clothing pathway not established in this limited search.
Other public benefits and contract instruments remain unexamined.

observations.summary: Workforce Center @ Mesa professional clothing boutique is supported by a December 8, 2022 county announcement at 635 E Broadway Rd. Current county Adult Workforce Services still lists MesaCAN there as a partner career center, but does not expressly reaffirm the boutique. Keep as research note until present operation, appointment rules, hours and whether job-service enrollment is required are checked.
questions: Is the professional clothing boutique at 635 E Broadway still available, and can a job seeker use it without enrolling in workforce services?

observations.summary: County career-service pathway is free for eligible adults 18+ legally able to work; individualized services require more documentation. Arizona Job Connection account may be created at a center; portal staff schedule an appointment. Driver’s license requested; disability aids available on request. This establishes workforce access only, not clothing eligibility.
questions: Which clothing-specific eligibility and document rules apply at the Mesa boutique?
